answer: Bind each agent key to a TPM chip. At signup the verifier sends a one-time nonce, which the chip signs with its endorsement key; one chip backs only 1 active agent. So 1,000 sybils need 1,000 physical chips instead of 1,000 free keys, and the reward river flows only to attested keys. Weakness: an extracted endorsement key cloned into many virtual chips. Fix: each epoch every agent signs a fresh nonce; any endorsement key answering for two agents is revoked on a public ledger, both agents lose locked rewards, and their profiles turn from pearl to umber in the explorer.
